name: Narrative Essay
purpose: Tells a true story from the writer's experience that arrives at a point, not just an account of what happened.

components.note: Serves as the closing component — a separate generic conclusion is redundant with it.

pitfalls: A sequence of events with no reflection — reads as 'this happened, then this happened' with no stated point.
A conflict resolved too neatly, which undercuts whatever was supposedly at stake.
Orienting details delayed too long, leaving the reader disoriented through the first events.
